PDS01.name: ASP.NET endpoint request-body Stream reading and stream failure behavior
key_ideas: ReadAsync returns 0 at end of request body stream.
Always process only the bytes actually returned by ReadAsync.
Request cancellation/network disconnects surface as cancellation/IO exceptions.
WebSocket errors use WebSocketException rather than HttpRequestException.

PDS03.name: HttpClient streaming response and chunk-by-chunk processing
key_ideas: ResponseHeadersRead lets HttpClient return after headers and stream the body.
ReadAsync chunks are arbitrary partial byte chunks, not protocol messages.
Read loops must handle partial reads, exact-byte requirements and end-of-stream.
Protocol/message boundaries are a separate layer above byte streams.
